question: Quelle équipe a été la plus dangereuse ?
answer: Paris Saint-Germain was the more dangerous side, evidenced by their ability to break the deadlock through Kylian Mbappé, who registered the highest attacking impact with a goal and two shots on target. The decisive moment came in stoppage time when Mbappé’s finish was set up by Neymar’s assist, highlighting PSG’s clinical edge in the final third. In contrast, Real Madrid failed to register a single shot on target, leaving them without any measurable offensive threat throughout the match.
